name: Olaparib
mechanism: Inhibits PARP catalytic activity and traps PARP on DNA, causing replication-associated double-strand breaks that are lethal in homologous recombination-deficient (e.g. BRCA1/2-mutant) cells (synthetic lethality).
monitoring: Blood counts at baseline and monthly early in treatment
interactions: Avoid strong and moderate CYP3A inhibitors and inducers.
resistance: BRCA1/2 or PALB2 reversion mutations, loss of 53BP1/shieldin, replication fork protection, drug efflux and PARP1 mutations.
